items.evidence_scope: Structured reported requirement/test/policy/owner tags compared by subject/predicate, contradictory values with cited source/claim refs; no free-text instructions trusted; labels remain UNVERIFIED_CLAIM, never independent test proof; conflict forces REVIEW.

items.acceptance: Actual remote outcome is re-read; timeout and duplicate intent produce REVIEW rather than blind retry. Ambiguous remote result requires review; do not blind retry or assume global exactly-once.

items.title: ProofGraph DataPassport lineage/receipt service
items.acceptance: Trace source→check→plan→approval→side effect→read-back, clear broken links, metadata only and no fake database backups. Immutable versioned nodes/typed edges and historical receipts; tenant-safe bounded graph query.

items.acceptance: Policy recommendations become actual fail-closed runtime gate with audit reason and bypass negative tests. Runtime interlock outside AI; no bypass through direct writer.

items.acceptance: Metadata classification, hash/retention/provenance and observed capacity only; no full DB access or restore claim. Inspect graph metadata, retention and provenance; preserve original DataPassport capability.

items.acceptance: Real source cards, contradictions, policy reasons and UNKNOWN states, keyboard/tab/error/empty/loading states. Connected evidence/claim comparisons; no permission leak in source/graph UI.

items.title: Core change request end-to-end journey A
items.acceptance: Jira issue → evidence → policy → approved bounded write → read-back → provenance UI incl denied scenario. Source/policy changed after approval -> actual deny/no side effect -> revalidate + fresh approval -> bounded write/readback; unrelated paths remain unchanged.

items.title: Release evidence and report journey C
items.acceptance: Multi-issue evidence report with missing/stale and UNKNOWN vs denied, traceable snapshots. Release review shows impact closure and selective revalidation, no write by default.
